description: Synthetic ES256 local-authorization vectors. JWS ES256 signatures are 64-byte R||S (RFC 7518 §3.4), never ASN.1 DER; header and payload must be parsed with duplicate-member rejection. Trust configuration below models the host instance store (SPEC §27.1); the JWKS is NOT a trust bootstrap. Expected outcomes follow claims.schema.json semantic rules. Private keys were ephemeral and discarded.

cases.name: signed by untrusted key with trusted kid
HS256 with public key as secret (algorithm confusion)
consent shows a different document than claims
duplicate claim via escaped member name
ECDSA signature in ASN.1 DER instead of R||S
